description: This file defines the Preg class, which provides static methods for regular expression operations such as match, matchAll, replace, and split. It acts as an abstraction over PHP's preg_* functions, adding error handling and support for strict match variants.

classes.name: Preg
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to perform regex operations with error handling and additional support features, serving as a wrapper around PHP's preg_* functions.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs regex pattern matching on a subject string, with options for capturing matches and handling errors.

methods.name: matchStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs regex matching and enforces all groups to be non-null, throwing if unmatched groups are encountered.

methods.name: matchWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs regex match with offset capturing, supporting PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE flag.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Performs global regex match and returns all matches.

methods.name: matchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs global regex match and enforces non-null matches for all groups.

methods.name: matchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs global regex match with offsets.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs regex-based replacement on a string.

methods.name: replaceCallback
methods.description: Performs regex replacements using a callback function.

methods.name: replaceCallbackStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs regex callback replacements with enforcement of non-null matched groups.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string by a regex pattern.

methods.name: splitWithOffsets
methods.description: Splits a string by a regex pattern and captures offsets.

methods.name: grep
methods.description: Filters an array of strings matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: isMatch
methods.description: Checks if a pattern matches a string, returning a boolean.

methods.name: isMatchStrictGroups
methods.description: Checks for match with strict non-null group enforcement.

methods.name: isMatchAll
methods.description: Checks if all matches exist for the pattern as a boolean.

methods.name: isMatchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Checks all matches with non-null group enforcement.

methods.name: isMatchWithOffsets
methods.description: Checks match with offsets, returning boolean.

methods.name: isMatchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Checks all matches with offsets, returning boolean.
